description:
Make every test image capture the event log through the end-of-log probe, make the capture layer refuse a whole read of the log, and delete the code that handles one.

## Background

`CaptureSpec::discover_paths` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs`), and `CaptureSpec::new` through it, accept `VirtualPath::EVENTS` as a whole path; only `discover_tail` reads its bounded end. By the time this lands, production captures use `discover_tail`, and whole-repository record fidelity reads the log through `RepositoryMutationSession::read_history_log`, outside `CaptureSpec`.

Test images still request it whole: the `image_with` helpers in `repository_state/mutation.rs` and `repository_state/archive.rs`; `repository_state/overlay.rs`; `repository_state/mod.rs`; the `image` helper in `repository_state/materialize.rs`; `commands/document.rs`; `captured_issue_spec` and `captured_gate_issue_spec` in `commands/mod.rs`; `commands/gate.rs`; and `storage/repository_state_store_tests.rs`. One test there requests the log as a tail and then whole, and asserts that `extend` upgrades the entry to its bytes; it must move to another path, since it owns upgrade behaviour rather than anything about the log.

The refusal leaves these arms dead: the whole arm of `captured_log_end` (`repository_state/mutation.rs`), its counterpart in `storage/repository_state_store.rs`, `repository_state/overlay.rs`, the `EVENTS` entry in `validate_capture_closure` (`repository_state/materialize.rs`) with the filter that drops it in `commands/validate.rs`, and the "already requested whole" branch of `discover_tail`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every listed test image and test spec captures the event log through `discover_tail`. Their assertions are unchanged, except the tail-to-whole upgrade test, which proves the same upgrade on another path.
- [hard] REQ-02: `CaptureSpec::new` and `discover_paths` return a capture error for `VirtualPath::EVENTS`, and one unit test owns the refusal. `read_history_log` is untouched.
- [hard] REQ-03: The listed whole-log arms no longer exist: a captured event-log entry is always a tail, and code that reads its length or final line handles only that form.
title: Captures refuse a whole read of the event log
